expected_behavior: Natural-language question with no filter words; the whole question is the topic.
expected_payload: {"organizations": [], "file_type": [], "exclude_organizations": [], "exclude_file_type": [], "any_of": [], "semantic_query": "how can teachers improve their classroom management skills"}

query: Foundational Learning resources
expected_behavior: A theme display name maps to its code. Filter-only request, so no residual query.

query: documents tagged with the School_Governance theme
expected_behavior: The theme code itself is accepted and copied exactly.

query: Inclusion documents from Involve
expected_behavior: Theme and organization are separate fields, ANDed.

query: PDFs in the Child Rights theme
expected_behavior: Theme and file type are ANDed; "in the ... theme" is consumed.

query: Community Engagement or Movement resources
expected_behavior: Same-field OR: one flat theme list, no alternatives.

query: Teaching and Learning Practises files from SEF about lesson planning
expected_behavior: A theme named as a label is a filter; the subject after "about" stays the topic.

query: system thinking
expected_behavior: A bare theme name on its own is a theme filter, in any casing.

query: everything except the Miscellaneous theme
expected_behavior: Theme exclusion only; never enumerate the other themes.

query: documents not in the Inclusion theme
expected_behavior: "not in the ... theme" excludes that theme.

query: Shikshalokam documents excluding the Movement theme
expected_behavior: Positive organization AND a theme exclusion.

query: PDF files except the Foundational Learning and Child Rights themes
expected_behavior: Positive file type; a same-field theme exclusion list excludes both themes.

query: all themes except System Thinking, and no DOCX
expected_behavior: "all themes" is unrestricted; the theme and file-type exclusions apply together.

query: Inclusion theme documents from all organizations except M4C
expected_behavior: Positive theme AND an organization exclusion.

query: Inclusion theme files from Involve or Movement theme files from SEE
expected_behavior: Each alternative carries its own organization and theme.

query: anything in the Child Rights theme, or any PDF from M4C
expected_behavior: A theme-only alternative OR an organization plus file-type alternative.

query: School Governance PDFs or Foundational Learning DOCX files
expected_behavior: Theme and file type differ in each alternative, so flattening would change the results.

query: Community Engagement documents from SEF or Community Engagement documents from Vidhya Vidhai
expected_behavior: The alternatives differ only in organization, so they merge into one flat filter.

query: Inclusion PDFs or Inclusion DOCX or System Thinking TXT files
expected_behavior: The two Inclusion alternatives merge; the System Thinking alternative stays separate.

query: documents from Shikshalokam, or anything not in the Miscellaneous theme
expected_behavior: An alternative may be a theme exclusion only, scoped to that alternative.

query: Teaching and Learning Practises files from Involve or Child Rights files from SEF, about classroom safety
expected_behavior: Two organization plus theme alternatives; the topic after them applies to both and is kept.
